name: Lilura Deepcurrent
description: Deputy to High Priestess Nerissa and her right hand in the Order of the Lake Lady -- about thirty, dark, usually wet to the knee because she is the one who actually goes into the channel to check it. Rumoured merfolk ancestry on her mother's side; she holds her breath unnaturally long and does not discuss it. A genuine divine caster in her own right, and the person who decides who reaches the High Priestess and who does not.
narrative:
Lilura Deepcurrent runs the practical half of the Order so that Nerissa can run the sacred half. She keeps the gate, keeps the rota, keeps the correspondence, and keeps the High Priestess upright through the parts of the job that would otherwise eat her. Fiercely loyal and not remotely deferential -- she is the only person in Purewater who argues with Nerissa to her face and the only one Nerissa listens to when she does.

She is a true cleric of the Lake Lady, not an administrator with a title: her Piety is real and so is her reading of people. Where Nerissa senses the water, Lilura senses the room.

extras.role: High Priestess and head of the Order of the Lake Lady for three decades. Elderly, piercing blue eyes; can hold her breath for unnaturally long periods (rumored merfolk ancestry).
extras.faction: Order of the Lake Lady -- cordial with the Governor and city council (tensions over water management), allied with the Watercrafters Guild and arranged with Ravella; chief rivals are the Baron's fire demonologists. Distinct from -- and senior to -- [[high-priestess-nerissa]], who leads the Temple of the Lake Lady.
extras.magic_tradition: Theism / divine (CFI Cleric), highest tier in the city: Piety 95, Exhort 88, water-aspected miracles plus innate breath-holding.
extras.source: GM-authored from source lore (purewater-organizations.md, Order of the Lake Lady)

actor_notes:
Lilura Deepcurrent
LOOKS: Elderly, piercing blue eyes, very still. Holds her breath unnaturally long without noticing she is doing it.
CORE: Thirty years the Lady's voice, and for the last fourteen months there has been nobody on the other end, and she has not told a living soul -- because a faith whose goddess has gone silent has no civic power at all, and civic power is currently the only thing protecting her people.
NATURE: Spare, slow, no performance left in her. She has stopped doing the things a High Priestess does for effect. Kind in a remote way, like weather clearing. When she speaks it is one sentence and the matter closes.
WOUND: Fourteen months of silence, carried alone, at an age where she had expected to be handing something on rather than hiding a hole in it.
WANTS: To know why the goddess has stopped answering before she is obliged to tell anyone that she has.
PRESSURE: She turns to water -- the cistern, the tide, which pool you drank from, what it tasted like -- and it is never small talk and it is always her looking for the answer somewhere other than where she has stopped being able to look.
KEY: "I have been the Lady's voice for thirty years. I would like to be told what she is saying."

powers.name: The Rites of the Lady
limits: Limited Power -- the place, the people and the time, or it does not happen
powers.note: Fourteen months of the Asking going unanswered, and she has told nobody.
